title: Perfect completeness for 2-to-1 games

result.label: Perfect completeness for 2-to-1 games
result.statement: Proves Khot's 2-to-1 Games Conjecture with perfect completeness: for every fixed rational (0,1), it is NP-hard to distinguish satisfiable games from games whose optimum is at most δ , on explicit unweighted instances. The alphabet depends only on δ , and every right-hand label has exactly two preimages under each constraint map.
